translations.web: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
translations.bsb: Now go! I will help you as you speak, and I will teach you what to say.”
translations.kjv: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
translations.asv: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt speak.
